'''Wargame simulation 4-9K''' was a combat simulation used by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The scenario simulating the fighting on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where combatants from each team would attempt to take control of artillery turrets in order to destroy the enemy's vessel.<ref>{{TORcite|type=warzone|Alderaan Civil War}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
